findings.claim: Oracle Project Jupiter 4 月擴約後 Bloom 為唯一電力供應商，主協議最高 2.8 GW（單一部落格來源，未對照一手文件）
findings.excerpt: Project Jupiter is Oracle's data center campus in New Mexico. Originally designed to use a mix of grid power, gas turbines, and Bloom fuel cells. The April 2026 expansion changed the design entirely: 2.45 GW grid-independent campus Sole power provider: Bloom Energy Gas turbines and diesel generators replaced entirely with Bloom Energy Servers Master agreement covers up to 2.8 GW total

findings.claim: 單一客戶占 2026 Q2 營收約 73%，且 FY2025 有 43% 客戶為經 Brookfield 合資的關聯方
findings.source: sec-api.io：Financial analysis of Bloom Energy Q2 2026 filings
findings.excerpt: Three customers made up 43%, 13% and 12% of FY2025 revenue; the 43% customer is a related party through the Brookfield joint ventures. One customer accounted for about 73% of Q2 2026 revenue (10-Q/A).

note: 兩次搜尋未找到最大客戶（Oracle／Brookfield 關聯方）導入第二供應商或自製燃料電池的來源。10-K 摘錄談的是 Bloom 自身供應商，與客戶端無關。僅有客戶集中度與 Oracle 為 Project Jupiter 唯一電力供應商的二手線索（見 clues）。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
